name: payment-sslcommerz
description: A payment provider on the SSLCOMMERZ hosted checkout for cards and wallets in Bangladesh; needs an SSLCOMMERZ store.

envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID: Your SSLCOMMERZ store id, from the merchant panel: register a sandbox store at https://developer.sslcommerz.com, or use the live store SSLCOMMERZ issues you. Read from apps/api/.env in local dev (saasaloy env, then pnpm env:setup) and from a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID`) in production. Unset, the provider reports `card` as unavailable and `create` answers method_unavailable; set but wrong, the gateway refuses the session and it surfaces as provider_error with the gateway's own failedreason.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD: The store password issued with SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID, sometimes called the API password. It is sent on the session-open POST, on every validation call and on every refund, so a deployed Worker holds it as a secret (`wrangler secret put SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD`), never in wrangler.jsonc.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_RECEIPT_EMAIL: A real mailbox you own, e.g. payments@yourdomain.com. SSLCOMMERZ requires cus_email on every session and mails its own receipt to it. A provider is handed an opaque payment reference and never learns the payer's address, so this is the one address it can name.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_MODE: Which gateway host to use: `sandbox` for https://sandbox.sslcommerz.com or `live` for https://securepay.sslcommerz.com. Optional, and it defaults to `sandbox`, so a deploy that never set it cannot take real money; any other value fails the env check.

removeWarnings: SSLCOMMERZ payments already in the payments table survive this removal. The core refuses to refund a payment whose provider is not registered, so finish refunds first or make them in the SSLCOMMERZ merchant panel.
The IPN URL stays registered in the SSLCOMMERZ merchant panel if you set one there. Remove it, or the gateway keeps posting to /payment/callback/sslcommerz/ipn, which then answers 404.
